text: The China–Singapore Joint Call for Proposals on “Climate Resilience & Adaptation” (2025) is a bilateral research funding initiative aimed at strengthening cross-border research collaborations between China and Singapore. It focuses on addressing priority adaptation challenges in urban systems, food systems, public health, and disaster risk, in response to the exceeded 1.5°C warming threshold. The initiative is part of larger national frameworks: CAS’s International Partnership Program in China and Singapore’s RIE2025 plan.
